AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Mave is a music, podcast, and audiobook streaming app with AI-generated content. Operational Patterns: - Use 'searchContent' to resolve show/episode names to IDs before calling 'playEpisode' or 'playPodcast'. - Use 'playAiSong' to generate and immediately play AI music from a text prompt. - Use 'addToQueue' to queue episodes without interrupting current playback. Constraints: - All playback functions require a valid showId or episodeId from the app's Firebase backend. - AI song generation may take up to 30 seconds; the function returns after playback begins.
